methodology: Dated ownership observations. No trade execution, cash-flow inference or recommendation. Performance starts at the first completed session after public tracking registration; it is not the manager's return.

observations.title: Domestic mutual funds and foreign investors diverged
observations.fact: Mutual-fund ownership rose from 22.77% to 29.00%; foreign institutional ownership fell from 13.96% to 8.86%.
observations.interpretation: Domestic ownership support strengthened while foreign ownership declined. This is not unanimous institutional agreement.
observations.watch: Operating performance, cash consumption and profitability. Disclosures do not establish investor motives or money moving from another stock.

observations.title: Mixed positioning across named investors
observations.fact: ICICI Prudential Focus Equity Fund: 2.85% to 3.19%; SBI Life: 2.52% to 2.69%; Franklin India Small Cap Fund: 2.33% to 1.37%; HDFC Multi Cap Fund: 2.38% to 2.32%.
observations.interpretation: Increases and reductions coexist. HDFC Mutual Fund and HDFC Life must be considered separately; newly disclosed insurance ownership does not prove a new purchase.
observations.watch: Loan growth, funding costs, margins and asset quality. These are AGI research priorities, not the investors' stated reasons.

observations.title: Appaloosa reported more TSM shares
observations.fact: Reported sponsored ADS holdings increased from 1,327,500 to 1,650,000, approximately 24.3%.
observations.interpretation: The reported share count increased. This does not establish current October positioning or the manager's net exposure.
observations.watch: Earnings, valuation and subsequent filings. 13F omits short positions and many other assets.

observations.title: Appaloosa reported fewer Micron shares
observations.fact: Reported holdings declined from 1,665,000 to 975,000 shares, approximately 41.4%.
observations.interpretation: Reported share counts fell. Portfolio weight alone is insufficient to infer buying because market prices also change.
observations.watch: Subsequent disclosures and operating results. A historical reduction is not a current short recommendation.
